expert_explanation: The major contribution of this work is not using Google search as the retriever. The main contribution of this paper is to leverage the most up-to-date information online, instead of those traditional open-book QA methods. Since the LLM's parametric knowledge and the quick evolution of online knowledge have become more and more popular recently (2023~2024), I think this paper's contribution is also solid at 2021~2022.
